# Test files that read what a sparse CI checkout leaves off disk, so
# tools/ci_test_shard.py always places them in shard 1, the one harness-tests
# shard with a full checkout. The other shards check out the `harness` profile
# of tools/sparse_checkout.py (blobless, without run archives and reference
# bundles), and .github/sparse-guard fails a sparse shard whose tests open or
# list an excluded path -- the failure names the file to add here.
#
# Measured 2026-10-10 by tracing every file the suite opens or lists; what
# each reads is noted.
tests/test_check_binstd_yield_archive.py  # archived BINSTD run raw results
tests/test_diffpath_adjudicator.py   # walks inputs/
tests/test_diffpath_controlpower.py  # walks inputs/
tests/test_gf2_kernels.py            # archived CERTBIN run outputs
tests/test_gf2_rankprofile.py        # archived CERTBIN run outputs
tests/test_p192_wcm_role2_interface.py  # archived SCURVE run receipts
tools/test_agent_bus.py              # lists the whole tree
tools/test_allocate_id.py            # lists the whole tree for ids
tools/test_build_frontier_map.py     # lists run directories
tools/test_build_source_index.py     # lists inputs/
tools/test_cairn_integration.py      # reads run records
tools/test_duplicate_run_ids.py      # reads every run manifest
tools/test_port_autolab_experiments.py  # imports Autolab source resolver, which probes inputs/refs
tools/test_ecc_priority.py           # lists run directories
tools/test_ecc_priority_dispositions.py  # lists run directories
tools/test_run_supersession.py       # reads run records
tools/test_validate_ledger.py        # validates every run record
